item.title: Stereo rebuild is alive — the used sub is not
item.description: The Kenwood and NVX five-channel amp are installed and operational, the Bose amp is bypassed and all four cabin speakers work. Channel 5 tested good, but the used KICKER L7T loaded 10 failed playback and a direct battery-pop test, so its return is underway and a replacement is next.

item.title: CEL is off after the battery reset — diagnosis continues
item.description: The catalyst CEL is currently off after the battery disconnect, but readiness also reset. Spark plugs are next, followed by a normal drive cycle and rescan before cats or O2 sensors are condemned.

item.title: Hood struts are on the way
item.description: Hood struts are ordered so the factory prop can retire — a small, useful quality-of-life upgrade.

item.title: Engine history audit completed
item.description: The VIN-specific CARFAX was re-audited. No spark-plug or ignition-coil replacement is documented, so plugs move onto the baseline list while coils remain diagnosis-only.

item.title: Catalyst code: diagnose before buying parts
item.description: A catalyst-related CEL is being worked from evidence first; the converter is not yet confirmed failed.
